settings.question: How do bundle discounts work?
settings.answer: Add 3 items, get 5% off. 5 items, 10%. 8 or more, 15%. The discount applies to your whole cart and you'll see it at checkout. No code needed.

settings.question: What counts as an item?
settings.answer: Each mag is one item. Each Snack Pack is one item. Each Membership is one item, no matter how many issues it includes.

settings.question: Can I mix print and digital in the same bundle?
settings.answer: Yes. Mix any format with any other format. Bundle a Print Membership with three digital singles and the discount kicks in just the same.

settings.question: What about Rolling Memberships?
settings.answer: Rolling Memberships count as 1 item toward your bundle. The bundle discount applies to your first Rolling drop. Future renewals charge at the usual rate.

settings.question: Is there a minimum bundle size?
settings.answer: No minimum to add items, but the discount only kicks in at 3 items. Below that, everything stays at the regular price.
